data.name: Manimaran
data.gender_notes: Manimaran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mani means 'jewel' and Maran means 'death' or 'God of Death'. Manimaran is a deity who is believed to grant wisdom and knowledge to his devotees, thereby helping them overcome the fear of death. This name is derived from the Tamil language and is popular among Hindus. The name Manimaran carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manimaran usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manimaran total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
